parameters.content:
## Job Search Autopilot — setup
1. Create the Google Sheet (tabs: Applied Log, Sends, Needs Verification, Replies, Follow-ups, Errors) — see SETUP.md.
2. Connect credentials: Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2, Google Gemini API (+ Google Drive for the resume).
3. Paste your Sheet ID, resume file ID and Apollo API key where marked YOUR_*.
4. Click Execute with Manual Trigger first. Only then activate the schedule.

## Hard rules (do not remove)
- Paid roles only. NEVER Internshala.
- NEVER mail an unverified email — unverified contacts go to Needs Verification.
- NEVER resend to bounced addresses: jobs@iion.io, rthornton@eteaminc.com, careers@hackshade.in, careers@techsima.com.
- 5-minute gap between sends (Wait node). Follow-ups are drafts only.

## Credentials — read before importing
Job Search Autopilot — credentials: none are set in this file. On import n8n shows 'No credential set' — connect your own Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2, Google Gemini API and Google Drive OAuth2. (Placeholder credential references that made n8n refuse to save on import were removed.)
Google Sheet ID and Drive resume file ID: replace YOUR_* placeholders in the nodes.
